description: Operational resource classes for live Agda targets. These are scheduling hints only; they do not change liveness, proof status, or typecheck requirements.

ordinary.description: Default target class; fresh Agda process per target through the existing checker.

long-cpu.description: Observed CPU-heavy target. Keep it live, but schedule it separately so it cannot dominate the ordinary frontier.

memory-risk.description: Observed high-memory target. Keep it live, run with reduced Agda parallelism and the repository RSS guard.

DASHI/Algebra/TriadicDepthTwoCyclotomicD.reason: Observed kernel OOM at about 6.45 GiB anon RSS while host swap was saturated; isolate at jobs=1 with a lower process ceiling.
